issues.description: Attribute naming mismatch: problem_statement.md (line 17) instructs students to add attributes named 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents', whereas the UML in problem_statement.md (lines 63-69) and the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 6-10) use the longer identifiers 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents'. This inconsistency can confuse students about the exact field names to implement, the expected constructor parameter ordering, and the expected getter/setter names.
issues.suggestedFix: Make attribute names consistent across artifacts. Update problem_statement.md (line 17) to list 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents' to match the UML and the tests/solution, or explicitly state that the short names 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents' are synonyms for the 'numberOf...' names and that students should implement the fields exactly as shown in the UML (to avoid test/constructor mismatches). Prefer aligning the problem text to the UML/tests to avoid breaking automated checks.
